title: Pay Multiple Bills at Once: Introducing Multi-Bill Payments
summary: Truss introduces Multi-Bill Payments, a game-changing feature that lets construction businesses pay multiple vendors simultaneously. This blog explains how the batch payment processing feature transforms hours of administrative work into minutes, improves vendor relationships through faster electronic payments, and seamlessly integrates with QuickBooks. Contractors learn the step-by-step workflow, discover real-world use cases for paying subcontractors and material suppliers, and understand how this tool strengthens cash flow management while eliminating paper check delays.
